CORTEX_DATABASE_URL == DEPLOYMENT_DATABASE_URL. Two stores, not three.

what_is_actually_broken: Bell 48027 holds 694 parcels inside Census McLennan County, up to 5.9 miles past the line, not duplicates of McLennan rows. Only wrong geometry in the set.
Bastrop serves 2,267 buildable envelopes whose rings were computed by the core that measured 0/12 on the operator test block, plus 1,785 ringless placeholders.
Eight counties totalling 2,467,879 parcels have geometry and zoning-facts but zero buildable-envelope atoms.
Travis cannot address 54.5% of its parcels and Tarrant 12.7% via the {fips}:{prop_id} atom key.
579,324 envelopes carry no recipeVersion, making Bexar/Travis/half-Williamson invisible to OPS-4 rewarm detection.
23 sentinel-keyed atom groups serve from production.
The runbook store topology is wrong: two secrets point at one database.
what_is_not_broken: Projection guard defect genuinely latent for all 19 - zero 202505 vintages, zero Mercator-scale coords, verified two ways.
Geometry sanity holds everywhere: zero rows outside Texas degree bounds, zero inverted bboxes.
Multipolygon truncation largely unrealized: 25,843 exposed but ~4,079 serve any positive envelope and essentially all are ringless Tier-1 rows.
Seam duplication matches FABRIC exactly and is not a correctness defect.
Bastrop has ZERO parcels with neither an envelope nor a decline - perfect 1:1 coverage, honesty doctrine holds.
Non-transactional write defect left no trace: no county is half-loaded.
what_i_could_not_determine: Whether Bell 694 out-of-county parcels are a load error or correct CAD-jurisdiction behavior - requires fetching the source shapefile. Highest-value follow-up, one download away.
Whether the dry/apply COMPUTE FORK (#279) affected these counties - requires paired dry/apply run artifacts, not store-resident. Any parity claim in the original run records remains suspect.
Whether a newer StratMap per-county edition exists - all 19 are on the current 2025 program but 10 are on the March edition, five months old.
True acreage exposed by truncation - no PostGIS, no source acreage column; ranked by parcel count deliberately since the acreage measure has already been wrong by 4.77x in this chain.
What the 770-refused / 369-declines.other Bastrop cohort resolved into - store shows no unnamed residue and perfect 1:1 coverage; batch-JSON counters are process memory, not store state.
Whether the eight zero-envelope counties deliberately stopped after the zoning bake or were abandoned mid-run.
Anything about the 60 counties loaded 2026-08-09 - out of scope by construction.
